verses.arabic: طه
verses.footnotes: [831]- See footnote to 2:1.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.translation: We have not sent down to you the Qur’ān that you be distressed

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to suffer, to be wretched, to be distressed

verses.arabic: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
verses.translation: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allāh] -

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
verses.translation: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,

verses.arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
verses.translation: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.[832]
verses.footnotes: [832]- i.e., having ascendancy over all creation. See footnotes to 2:19 and 7:54.

segments.gloss: to be equal, to be alike, to establish

verses.arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
verses.translation: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
verses.translation: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verses.translation: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.

verses.arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.translation: And has the story of Moses reached you? -

verses.arabic: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًى
verses.translation: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
verses.translation: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verses.translation: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the blessed valley of Ṭuwā.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.translation: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
verses.translation: Indeed, I am Allāh. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.translation: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it[833] - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
verses.footnotes: [833]- Meaning that Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) keeps knowledge of the Hour hidden from everyone except Himself.

segments.gloss: to be near, to nearly do, to almost do

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
verses.translation: So do not let one avert you from it[834] who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
verses.footnotes: [834]- From preparation for the Hour or for the Hereafter.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to turn away, to avert, to hinder

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translation: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.translation: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translation: [Allāh] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."

segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ
verses.translation: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.

segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.translation: [Allāh] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.translation: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, feminine, singular
segments.gloss: to go out, to come out, to depart, to leave

verses.arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
verses.translation: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.translation: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed [i.e., tyrannized]."

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand [i.e., relax] for me my breast [with assurance]

verses.arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.translation: And ease for me my task

verses.arabic: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى
verses.translation: And untie the knot from my tongue

verses.arabic: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
verses.translation: That they may understand my speech.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
verses.translation: And appoint for me a minister [i.e., assistant] from my family -

verses.arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى
verses.translation: Aaron, my brother.

verses.arabic: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
verses.translation: Increase through him my strength

verses.arabic: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.translation: And let him share my task

verses.arabic: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.translation: That we may exalt You much

verses.arabic: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.translation: And remember You much.

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا
verses.translation: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translation: [Allāh] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 2nd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
verses.translation: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.translation: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُۥ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
verses.translation: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me[835] that you would be brought up under My eye [i.e., observation and care].
verses.footnotes: [835]- Allāh put love of Moses into the hearts of the people.

segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to hurl
to cast, to throw, to hurl

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular, passive
segments.gloss: to make, to construct, to do

words.gloss: and that you may be brought up

verses.arabic: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًا فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translation: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone,[836] but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
verses.footnotes: [836]- The Copt who died after being struck by Moses.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

segments.gloss: to indicate, to show, to direct

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to take charge, to nurse, to rear

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, feminine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, feminine, singular

segments.gloss: to persecute, to test, to try
to remain, to stay, to hesitate, to delay

verses.arabic: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
verses.translation: And I produced you for Myself.[837]
verses.footnotes: [837]- Allāh had already selected Moses and made him strong in body and character according to the requirements of his mission.

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
verses.translation: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.translation: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

verses.arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
verses.translation: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allāh]."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
verses.translation: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
verses.translation: [Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

verses.arabic: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.translation: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace[838] will be upon he who follows the guidance.
verses.footnotes: [838]- i.e., safety and security from Allāh's punishment.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.translation: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.'"

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
verses.translation: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَٰبٍ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to go astray, to err, to lose

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّن نَّبَاتٍ شَتَّىٰ
verses.translation: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.

segments.gloss: to bring forth, to drive out

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَٰمَكُمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.translation: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.

verses.arabic: مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.translation: From it [i.e., the earth] We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.

segments.gloss: to bring forth, to drive out

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
verses.translation: And We certainly showed him [i.e., Pharaoh] Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translation: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to bring forth, to drive out

verses.arabic: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى
verses.translation: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."[839]
verses.footnotes: [839]- Literally, "marked," as to be known. Another meaning is "a place midway [between us]" or "a level place."

words.gloss: Then we will surely produce for you

verses.arabic: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًى
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."[840]
verses.footnotes: [840]- So that the signs of Allāh would be seen clearly.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
verses.translation: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
verses.translation: Moses said to them [i.e., the magicians summoned by Pharaoh], "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allāh or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ
verses.translation: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ
verses.translation: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way [i.e., religion or tradition].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, dual
segments.gloss: to intend, to desire, to want, to wish

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, dual
segments.gloss: to bring forth, to drive out

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, dual

verses.arabic: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّا وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ
verses.translation: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."

segments.gloss: to resolve, to agree, to put together

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
verses.translation: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer
to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer

verses.arabic: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.translation: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].

segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةً مُّوسَىٰ
verses.translation: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.

verses.arabic: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.translation: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
verses.translation: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."

segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, feminine, singular

segments.gloss: to make, to construct, to do
to make, to construct, to do

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verses.translation: So the magicians fell down in prostration.[841] They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
verses.footnotes: [841]- After they had seen the miracles which Allāh had given Moses and that they were realities and not merely impressions of magic.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer

segments.description: Active participle — accusative, masculine, plural, indefinite

verses.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."

words.gloss: So surely I will cut off
and surely I will crucify you

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ
verses.translation: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us.[842] So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
verses.footnotes: [842]- This phrase has also been interpreted as an oath, i.e., "...by Him who created us."

segments.gloss: to decree, to decide, to judge

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to decree, to decide, to judge

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.translation: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allāh is better and more enduring."[843]
verses.footnotes: [843]- In reward and in punishment.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجْرِمًا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.translation: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَأْتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنًا قَدْ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلْعُلَىٰ
verses.translation: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.translation: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.[844]
verses.footnotes: [844]- From all uncleanliness, the greatest of which is worship and obedience to other than Allāh.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكًا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verses.translation: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verses.translation: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,[845]
verses.footnotes: [845]- i.e., not only the water but that which only Allāh knows - terror, pain, regret, etc.

verses.arabic: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
verses.translation: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].

segments.gloss: to let go astray, to mislead

verses.arabic: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَٰكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ
verses.translation: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you[846] at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
verses.footnotes: [846]- i.e., with your prophet, to receive the scripture for you.

words.gloss: and We made a covenant with you

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ
verses.translation: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen [i.e., perished]."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.translation: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translation: [Allāh said], "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ هُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ
verses.translation: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.translation: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī[847] has led them astray."
verses.footnotes: [847]- Translated as "the Samaritan" (from Samaria), a hypocrite among them who led the Children of Israel into idol-worship.

segments.gloss: to persecute, to test, to try
to let go astray, to mislead

verses.arabic: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَٰنَ أَسِفًا قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِى
verses.translation: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved.[848] He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise?[849] Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"
verses.footnotes:
[848]- The meaning may also be "angry and enraged."
[849]- That He would send down the Torah, containing guidance for you.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

segments.gloss: to intend, to desire, to want, to wish

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَآ أَوْزَارًا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.translation: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Sāmirī throw."

segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to hurl
to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer

verses.arabic: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ
verses.translation: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."

segments.gloss: to bring forth, to drive out

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا
verses.translation: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech [i.e., response] and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى وَأَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرِى
verses.translation: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 2nd person, masculine, plural, passive
segments.gloss: to persecute, to test, to try

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ
verses.translation: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to it [i.e., the calf] until Moses returns to us."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوٓا۟
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,

segments.gloss: to go astray, to err, to lose

verses.arabic: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِى
verses.translation: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَأْسِىٓ إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى
verses.translation: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.'"

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِىُّ
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Sāmirī?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةً مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِى نَفْسِى
verses.translation: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger[850] and threw it,[851] and thus did my soul entice me."
verses.footnotes:
[850]- i.e., a hoof-print in the sand left by the angel Gabriel's horse.
[851]- Into the fire upon the melted ornaments in order to form the calf.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, plural

segments.gloss: to withhold, to withdraw, to close

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًا لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.'[852] And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast.
verses.footnotes: [852]- i.e., Do not touch me. As chastisement, he was to be completely shunned by all people.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular, passive

segments.gloss: to scatter, to blow away, to blast

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا
verses.translation: Your god is only Allāh, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ وَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًا
verses.translation: Thus, [O Muḥammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us a message [i.e., the Qur’ān].

verses.arabic: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وِزْرًا
verses.translation: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden [i.e., great sin],

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِ وَسَآءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ حِمْلًا
verses.translation: [Abiding] eternally therein,[853] and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
verses.footnotes: [853]- i.e., in the state of sin.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ وَنَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ زُرْقًا
verses.translation: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.[854]
verses.footnotes: [854]- From terror, or blinded completely.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًا
verses.translation: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

segments.gloss: to remain, to stay, to hesitate, to delay

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا
verses.translation: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner [i.e., wisdom or speech] will say, "You remained not but one day."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

segments.gloss: to remain, to stay, to hesitate, to delay

verses.arabic: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًا
verses.translation: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.[855]
verses.footnotes: [855]- Once they have been reduced to dust.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to scatter, to blow away, to blast

verses.arabic: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا
verses.translation: And He will leave it [i.e., the earth] a level plain;

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَآ أَمْتًا
verses.translation: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًا
verses.translation: That Day, they [i.e., everyone] will follow [the call of] the Caller[856] [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
verses.footnotes: [856]- To the gathering for judgement.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًا
verses.translation: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلْمًا
verses.translation: He [i.e., Allāh] knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them,[857] but they do not encompass it [i.e., what He knows] in knowledge.
verses.footnotes: [857]- Allāh’s knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا
verses.translation: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining.[858] And he will have failed who carries injustice.[859]
verses.footnotes:
[858]- See footnotes describing these attributes in 2:255.
[859]- i.e., sin or wrongdoing towards Allāh or any of His creation.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًا وَلَا هَضْمًا
verses.translation: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا
verses.translation: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān[860] and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
verses.footnotes: [860]- i.e., revealed in the Arabic language.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا
verses.translation: So high [above all] is Allāh, the Sovereign,[861] the Truth.[862] And, [O Muḥammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur’ān before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
verses.footnotes:
[861]- And owner of everything in existence.
[862]- Or "the True Reality," i.e., the real and permanent existence upon which all other existence depends.

segments.gloss: to be exalted, to be high

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
segments.gloss: to decree, to decide, to judge

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُۥ عَزْمًا
verses.translation: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.[863]
verses.footnotes: [863]- To resist temptation.

segments.gloss: to make a covenant, to promise

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
verses.translation: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees;[864] he refused.
verses.footnotes: [864]- See footnote to 2:34.

verses.arabic: فَقُلْنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.translation: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to bring forth, to drive out

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to suffer, to be wretched, to be distressed

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ
verses.translation: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ
verses.translation: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ
verses.translation: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"

segments.gloss: to indicate, to show, to direct

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ
verses.translation: And they [i.e., Adam and his wife] ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, dual

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ
verses.translation: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۢا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ
verses.translation: [Allāh] said, "Descend from it [i.e., Paradise] - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to go astray, to err, to lose

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to suffer, to be wretched, to be distressed

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ
verses.translation: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed [i.e., difficult] life, and We will gather [i.e., raise] him on the Day of Resurrection blind."

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِىٓ أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًا
verses.translation: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ ءَايَٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ
verses.translation: [Allāh] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot [i.e., disregarded] them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.translation: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.[865]
verses.footnotes: [865]- Than that of this world.

segments.gloss: to be extravagant, to exceed, to transgress

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.translation: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى
verses.translation: And if not for a word[866] that preceded from your Lord, it [i.e., punishment] would have been an obligation [due immediately],[867] and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
verses.footnotes:
[866]- See footnote to 10:19.
[867]- Allāh would have punished the disbelievers in this world as He did with previous peoples.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ
verses.translation: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.translation: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, feminine, singular
segments.gloss: to spread, to extend, to prolong
to grant, to bestow, to provide
to persecute, to test, to try

verses.arabic: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا لَا نَسْـَٔلُكَ رِزْقًا نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ وَٱلْعَٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
verses.translation: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.

segments.gloss: to be patient, to be steadfast

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.translation: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?[868]
verses.footnotes: [868]- Is not the Qur’ān an adequate proof of Muḥammad's prophethood and sufficient as a lasting miracle?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِعَذَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
verses.translation: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him,[869] they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses [i.e., teachings] before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
verses.footnotes: [869]- Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ). Also interpreted as "before it," i.e., the Qur’ān.

verses.arabic: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.translation: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting;[870] so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
verses.footnotes: [870]- For the outcome of this matter.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural
